# Post-Campaign Learning Log

| Learning | Evidence | Impact on objective | Confidence | Reusable implication | Owner |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|

## Reflection
- What should be repeated?
- What should change?
- Which assumptions were wrong?
- Which audience or channel behaved differently than expected?
- What should be tested next?

Separate execution issues from strategic learning. Capture learnings while evidence is fresh and link them to future briefs or planning cycles.
